name: Apartment putt
summary: A mini-golf hole drawn as the apartment's floor plan: putt from the front door around the couch, under the table, past the rice cooker to the cup in the bathroom. Drag back from your ball to aim and set power, then putt; the ball bounces off walls and furniture the same way on every phone, every friend's ball sits where it stopped with their face, and fewest strokes wins the week.
useWhen: mini golf but the course is our apartment
hole of the week at 412 pine, bathroom is the cup
a putting game in our living room
who can sink it past arun's rice cooker
something silly to play from the couch
dontUseWhen: planning a real mini golf outing (use friends-plans)
a puzzle with moves to count (use lot-escape)
assigning rooms or chores in the apartment (use chore-wheel)
